sources.title: Clean Your System and Free Disk Space
sources.excerpt: Wipe out temporary files, browser caches, logs, and hidden junk hoarding your precious storage. ... All features work offline and without registration or license activation. ... Open source under GPLv3. No ads. No upsells.
sources.scope: Unversioned vendor description; not a network/privacy/performance audit. Homepage explicitly links github.com/bleachbit/bleachbit.

sources.title: Download BleachBit
sources.excerpt: BleachBit for Mac OS X: Experimental support with limited features. ... The latest stable release is 6.0.4. ... No payment or registration is required. Donations are appreciated, though.
sources.scope: Free desktop offer. FAQ latest-version wording conflicts with current platform pages/October 17 announcement; do not repeat its 6.0.4 latest claim.

sources.title: BleachBit on macOS
sources.excerpt: All non-GUI tests pass on macOS Tahoe (26) with Python 3.9 ... master branch supports CLI and GTK GUI on macOS ... master branch supports native macOS functionality such as cleaning Safari, macOS trash, and detecting the user's language ... Future steps include: improving support for macOS-specific cleaners, testing, creating a .dmg (disk image), and digital signature.
sources.scope: Vendor master-branch progress, not our tests or minimum supported OS/Python. GTK guide uses Homebrew Python, GTK3, pygobject3, adwaita-icon-theme and requirements.txt; wx-gui-mvp uses wxPython >=4.2 and lags master; TUI branch experimental. No commands executed.

sources.title: BleachBit 6.0.6
sources.excerpt: BleachBit 6.0.6 is a maintenance release ... Add cleaners for the Helium browser and Docker Desktop (Windows, Linux, and macOS), including Docker's AI assistant ... Clean more cache and session files in Claude Code on all platforms, and detect it running on macOS ... Add macOS support to Visual Studio Code and forks.
sources.scope: Release-note behavior, not executed validation or proof of signed Mac binary. Performance assertions excluded from proposed claims.

sources.title: Features
sources.excerpt: Simple to operate: read the descriptions, check the boxes you want, click preview, and click delete. ... Command line interface for scripting and automation ... Advanced users can write their own cleaners using CleanerML ... Cookie manager: select which cookies to keep ... Add thousands of cleaners by using winapp2.ini (Windows only). ... Overwrite free disk space to hide previously deleted files
sources.scope: Documented selection/preview/deletion and extensibility, not risk-free cleanup, all-OS cleaner parity or erasure effectiveness.

article.title: Moving a BleachBit cleanup workflow to a Mac
article.primaryIntent: Existing Windows/Linux BleachBit user chooses between experimental Mac source support and Mac-focused storage/app investigation, not a Windows replacement sales page.
article.leadDirection: Experimental Mac support exists, but documented source setup differs from packaged Windows/Linux use. Choose by task and willingness to use an experimental build, not imagined speed/savings.
outline: Platform/setup fork first; historical BleachBit preview immediately after lead
Translate selection/Preview into review checklist: data purpose, backup/rebuild cost, permissions, deletion versus free space
Explain experimental Mac GTK/wx/TUI choices without untested runnable installation steps
Separate privacy traces, developer caches and ongoing storage ownership using release-scoped examples
Show labeled Breathing Room Space preview; one bounded recommendation with we-build disclosure and preview/Python/hosted caveats
Finish with decision criteria, not superiority claims
article.interactionPass: Draft-stage handoff: non-mutating checklist for target OS, willingness to run source/dependencies, and privacy traces versus storage/app investigation. Explain outcome. No cleanup button, filesystem access, accounts or forced code demo.
article.toolLink: Only link cache/rebuild checklist tool after verifying an existing route; no invented destination.
article.uniqueness: Transfer a familiar cleaner/preview mental model across OSs, including newly experimental Mac support; not a generic alternatives template.
